record.reason: LLM agents automate GPU kernel optimization by repeatedly composing candidates and measuring their duration on real GPUs. Existing systems preserve measurement fidelity by reserving a GPU for an entire agent session or benchmarking command. However, this results in poor utilization because only a small fraction of command execution requires exclusive GPU access.
